passages.title: Our National Day Ceremony
passages.text: On National Day, our junior college held an observance ceremony in the hall. We ⟦1|recite⟧ the pledge together and watched a performance by the dance club. It reminded us how much we ⟦2|shair⟧ as one people.
passages.say: On National Day, our junior college held an observance ceremony in the hall. We recited the pledge together and watched a performance by the dance club. It reminded us how much we share as one people.
